newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index edges lower in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index edges lower in active trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed lower by 0.14 percent on Friday in active trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 547.5 from 548.28 on Thursday.
Volume was 3.4 million dinars against 435,126 dinars. Turnover on the occasional market was 1.5 million dinars.
UBCI bank was up 1.34 dinar to 47.3.
Airliner Tunis Air was down 0.62 dinar to 16 dinars. Coca and beer bottler SFBT eased 0.5 dinar to 87.
